operation.description:
Sets the customization template and `opt-in` or `opt-out` flag for an OpenID Connect (OIDC) subject claim for a repository.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

schema.description: Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository

include_claim_keys.description: Array of unique strings. Each claim key can only contain alphanumeric characters and underscores.

use_default.description: Whether to use the default template or not. If `true`, the `include_claim_keys` field is ignored.

use_immutable_subject.description: Whether to opt in to the immutable OIDC subject claim format for this repository. When `true`, OIDC tokens will use a stable, repository-ID-based `sub` claim.

schema.title: Actions OIDC subject customization for a repository

operation.summary: Set the customization template for an OIDC subject claim for a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.
